Full name 11 Jan 2022 • 5 min read The Catalyst Fund is a VC fund and accelerator backing early-stage tech entrepreneurs who are scaling solutions for a climate-resilient future in Africa.
While contributing less than 4% to carbon emission, Africa is a powerful hub for climate tech innovation.

Due to its natural assets, abundant arable land and renewable energy, growing workforce and tech talent, and ability to leapfrog technology developments, African innovators can build solutions to enable a low carbon future and increase the resilience of 1.5 billion people on the continent.

The climate innovation opportunity is valued at $2.8t by 2030 and the benefits are clear: increased agricultural production, higher household incomes, improved environmental services, long term assets, and reduced vulnerability to extreme weather events.
In the face of climate impacts, every sector of the economy will need to adapt.
The time to invest in climate resilience is now.

As a venture capital fund and venture builder, we partner with visionary founders who are developing high-impact climate adaptation solutions to enhance the resilience of communities and the planet. Our investments span critical sectors including climate-smart agritech and food systems, climate insurance, land
Our investments span critical sectors including climate-smart agritech and food systems, climate insurance, land restoration, cold chain, waste management, clean energy, and water management.
What sets us apart is our active, hands-on venture-building approach at the pre-seed stage.

Catalyst Fund began its journey in 2015 as a global accelerator managed by BFA Global, targeting early-stage inclusive fintech startups dedicated to improving the financial health of underserved communities across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

In 2019, we scaled our accelerator with support from the UK Foreign Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO), PayPal, and Mastercard Foundation, expanding our reach to 36 additional inclusive tech startups in Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, India, and Mexico.

The Catalyst Fund accelerator addressed critical gaps in emerging market innovation ecosystems, such as insufficient capital for early-stage product testing and iteration, a lack of necessary skills for building viable solutions for underserved customers, and limited connections between local founders and global investors and corporate partners.

Our approach combined catalytic grant capital, bespoke venture-building support from seasoned operators and market experts, and access to a global network of investors and corporates, while also sharing valuable insights with the broader inclusive tech ecosystem.

Aligned with our mission to empower entrepreneurs addressing the most significant challenges of our time, we launched our first equity fund in 2022 to support founders tackling the urgent global issue of climate change.
